source_name: INSEE SIDE — Stock d'établissements par zone d'emploi (publication directe)
download_command_or_manual_steps: Go to https://www.insee.fr/fr/statistiques/2012694 → download annual files. Cross-check ZE2020 codes with commune_to_ze2020_2026.csv
risk_notes: SIDE creation data is already HERALD target variable. Do NOT use as feature — only as cross-check. Note: SIDE creation ≠ stock (stock = all active establishments at date; creation = new registrations in year)

source_name: INSEE CLAP — Emploi salarié localisé par zone d'emploi
download_command_or_manual_steps: Go to INSEE CLAP publication → download Excel for each year → extract employment by ZE2020 × A10 sector
risk_notes: CLAP gives salaried employment only (not non-salaried). Self-employed excluded. T+18 months lag. Coverage: metropolitan France only. Last published year may be 2019 or 2020 — verify current availability.

source_name: Harvard OEC — Product Complexity Index (PCI) by HS4
api_or_manual: PARTIAL — OEC API (limited free tier); Harvard Dataverse full download
years_needed: 2019 (current in IAT); optionally 2021 or 2023 for update
download_command_or_manual_steps: (1) Go to https://oec.world/en/resources/data → Product Complexity → download HS4 complexity CSV. (2) Alternative: Harvard Dataverse https://dataverse.harvard.edu/dataverse/atlas → search 'product complexity'. (3) Columns needed: hs4_code + pci
risk_notes: PCI vintage does not need to match training year. 2019 PCI safe for all HERALD years (2012-2027). NAF→HS4 proximity crosswalk (nomenclature_activity_product_proximity) must be available to weight PCI per establishment.

source_name: INSEE Tableaux Entrées-Sorties (TES) — IO table NACE
download_command_or_manual_steps: Go to https://www.insee.fr/fr/statistiques/2022724 → download Excel TES symmetrical 2019 → extract input-output coefficient matrix at NACE A64 level
risk_notes: TES symmetric IO table published with ~3-year lag. 2019 TES available now. 2020 TES expected ~2024. Use same 2019 IO table for all HERALD years (structural benchmark). NACE code format in TES may differ from IAT (dot notation: '01.11' vs integer): verify before join.

expected_file_format: TSV or JSON via eurostat Python package
download_command_or_manual_steps: import eurostat; df = eurostat.get_data_df('naio_10_cp1750')  # symmetric IO table at current prices NACE A64
risk_notes: Alternative to INSEE TES if French TES unavailable for specific year. Eurostat covers EU28 at NACE A64 level. French row/column in Eurostat SUTS.

source_name: Douanes françaises DGDDI — export/import par département
target_features: export_rca_strength import_dependency_score (not yet in v1; planned for dynamic layer)
download_command_or_manual_steps: Go to Douanes website → Statistiques du commerce extérieur → download annual Excel files by department and HS4 code. No API available.
risk_notes: Only needed if export RCA features are added to dynamic layer. Not needed for v1 static features. T+18 months lag. Coverage: metropolitan departments (01-95 + 2A/2B). Must aggregate department→ZE2020 via population weighting or dominant-ZE mapping.

source_name: CEPII BACI — world trade flows by HS4 and country
target_features: export_rca_strength (world denominator for Balassa RCA — not yet in v1)
download_command_or_manual_steps: (1) Register at CEPII website. (2) Download BACI HS17 (2019 vintage). (3) Aggregate to HS4 for world totals by product.
risk_notes: Only needed for world-level RCA denominator (export_rca_strength feature). Not needed for v1 static features. Large file (~2 GB). BACI harmonizes COMTRADE bilateral trade data.
